title: Cannot sign in: locks, disabled accounts and timeouts
summary: Distinguish an account lock from network throttling, and know when to restart or contact your administrator.
scenes: Disabled accounts and expired sign-in steps
Too many attempts from the network

steps.say: Repeated wrong passwords or verification codes can lock an account. Stop guessing and read the message MERIT gives you.
The account is locked for fifteen minutes. Wait until it unlocks or ask an administrator to unlock it after verifying your identity.
onScreen: Too many failed attempts. The account is locked for 15 minutes; an administrator can unlock it.

steps.say: Even a correct password does not bypass the lock. A password-reset link also does not bypass it.
After the wait or a confirmed unlock, start again with the correct password and authenticator.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)

steps.say: A disabled or unknown account gets a general sign-in error. If the details are correct but access still fails, contact your administrator.
onScreen: The user name or password is not right.

steps.say: A sign-in verification page can expire. If MERIT sends you back to sign in, enter your password again and use a fresh code.
onScreen: Sign in to MERIT · Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required. · User name * · Password * · Forgot your password? · Continue · After your password you will be asked for a code from your authenticator app. Multi-factor authentication is required for every account. · One registry for metals exposure · Laboratory results for lead, arsenic, mercury and cadmium, matched to one record per person. ·

steps.say: Too many attempts from one network is a separate limit. This training instance demonstrates that message without affecting other users.
Wait for the number of seconds shown, then use Back to sign in. Repeated retries do not remove either a network limit or an account lock.
onScreen: Too many attempts · Too many sign-in attempts came from your network in the last minute. Wait 60 seconds, then try again. · Back to sign in · Repeated wrong passwords or codes also lock the account for a while. If you are locked out, ask your administrator.

steps.say: If the problem continues, tell support which message you see and your user name. Do not send your password, setup key, recovery codes or verification codes.
actions: Types into Six-digit code from your authenticator app (hidden)
